## Research and Teaching Interests

**Methodological research:** Bayesian multilevel modeling and prior specification for small samples; measurement modeling for sparse and imbalanced data.

**Applied research:** Quantitative methods for measurement and program evaluation in education and social research.

**Teaching:** Multilevel modeling; Bayesian data analysis; applied measurement; quantitative research methods.

**Statistical Consultant.** REBOOT Award. New York University, 2025.
